sources.title: OpenAI Codex changelog
sources.takeaway: The 2026-06-11 Codex app 26.609 entry adds Browser Developer Mode for Chrome and the Codex in-app browser, with controlled CDP access for performance, network, console, runtime, and page-state debugging; it also says Browser use is up to 2x faster through CDP and DOM snapshot optimizations.
sources.phase_use: Use Browser Developer Mode as a bounded diagnostic surface for the Lumen route, while still treating signed-in ChatGPT panel delivery as status-only evidence.

sources.title: OpenAI Codex 0.140.0 GitHub release
sources.takeaway: Codex 0.140.0 adds usage views, larger goal preservation, session deletion with safeguards, selective import flows, unified mentions, MCP reliability fixes, and large-repository responsiveness improvements.
sources.phase_use: Use the 0.140.0 line to improve goal-continuity, current-state beacons, MCP warning handling, and large-repo lookup discipline.
